scenario.title: Linen renewal on schedule
scenario.setting: A head of procurement at Greenfield Regional Hospital whose assistant keeps minutes of vendor negotiation calls and contract renewal dates

items.text: Norlake Cleaning Supplies quotes a standard delivery lead time of 15 working days from order confirmation for all standing orders to the hospital.

The Brightpath Linen Services contract with Greenfield Regional Hospital runs until 31 December 2026, and the renewal rate agreed at last year's negotiation is $48,500 per year for the full linen service.
Dana Wells is the Brightpath Linen Services account representative handling the Greenfield Regional Hospital contract, and all renewal paperwork goes through her.

Every contract renewal above $10,000 per year needs three quotes on file before it is signed, but a renewal with an incumbent whose rate was negotiated within the last eighteen months counts as already quoted.
Minutes of every vendor negotiation call are circulated to all attendees within 48 hours of the call.
Only the head of procurement signs supplier contracts for Greenfield Regional Hospital; no one else may sign on her behalf.
Medisafe Waste Co collects clinical waste from the hospital on Tuesday and Friday mornings, with a combined weekly volume of about 40 bins.
The central stores room on level B holds about 2 cubic metres of spare linen, enough for roughly four days of normal ward demand.
The staff cafeteria coffee contract with Brewmans costs $1,150 per month and renews automatically each March.
Renew the Brightpath Linen Services contract for calendar year 2027 at $48,500 per year, the rate agreed with Dana Wells, since the rate was negotiated eleven months ago and counts as already quoted.
The pharmacy's two sample fridges are serviced twice a year by PolarTech Refrigeration under a maintenance agreement.
Keep Medisafe clinical waste collection as it stands, with Tuesday and Friday morning pickups, and take no action on the competitor that offered Monday-only collection.
Circulate the minutes of the 8 September negotiation call with Brightpath to all attendees. Done on 10 September, within the 48-hour window.
PolarTech charges $3,200 per year for the twice-yearly fridge maintenance visits under a rolling agreement.
Approve the PolarTech maintenance agreement at $3,200 per year for another two years, since it is below the $10,000 threshold that requires quotes.
The visitor parking contract with Cityspace Parking runs to 30 June 2027 at $880 per month.
Set Friday 6 November 2026 as the deadline to sign and send the Brightpath renewal paperwork for 2027 to Dana Wells, well ahead of the 31 December contract end.
The hospital's annual deep-clean by an outside crew is booked for the last week of January 2027.
Cedarfresh Linen submitted an unsolicited quote of $52,400 per year to take over the hospital's full linen service from January 2027.
Decline the Cedarfresh Linen quote of $52,400 per year and stay with Brightpath, since the Cedarfresh price is higher than the agreed $48,500 renewal rate.
The procurement office's shared printer is leased from Officeprint at $95 per month until May 2028.
Sign and send the Brightpath Linen renewal for 2027 at $48,500 per year to Dana Wells. Not done yet; due Friday 6 November.
Reconcile the Medisafe Waste Co invoices against the pickup log for the autumn quarter. Not done yet; due 15 December.
Marta's office hours on Fridays are 9:00 to 13:00, and she signs all pending contracts before lunch.
Norlake Cleaning Supplies bills the hospital $640 per month for cleaning consumables on a rolling basis.
